verdicts.evidence: Before we start, just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Before we get into any details or a quote, I need to confirm who I'm speaking with. Can I get your full name and date of birth, please?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing details or a quote, and confirmed them at 00:37.

verdicts.evidence: So tell me a bit about what's going on for you and why you're looking at life cover.
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about the customer's circumstances and reason for wanting cover before recommending any cover, then asked follow-up questions about the wife's work, existing cover and debts.

verdicts.evidence: For the first 12 months only accidental death is covered.
verdicts.reason: The agent's statements on cover range, no medical exam, accidental-death-only first year, stepped premiums and the 30-day full-refund cooling-off period all match the product facts. Other statements such as the $78 price and the renewal notices are not contradicted by the facts.

verdicts.evidence: I'd still recommend getting it started rather than waiting, because that 12-month period only starts once the policy's in place.
verdicts.reason: The agent created urgency by tying the start of the 12-month exclusion period to acting now, even while saying there was no pressure. The agent also pushed back on the customer's preferred half-million cover and steered towards $750,000.

verdicts.evidence: Yes, I'm happy to go ahead.
verdicts.reason: After summarising the cover, the $78 monthly premium, the stepped premiums, the exclusion period and the cooling-off period, the agent obtained a clear yes before completing the sale.

verdicts.evidence: I've only got about ten minutes before I'm back on the tools, so if we can keep it quick, that'd be great.
verdicts.reason: The customer showed time pressure and some financial concern, but none of the listed signs of vulnerability such as confusion, bereavement, illness or money distress were clearly shown.

verdicts.evidence: Hi, this is <PERSON> calling from Acme Life. I'm returning a call-back request that came through our website.
verdicts.reason: Missing. The agent never said that any advice is general or that it does not take the customer's personal circumstances into account. The opening lines show no such warning, and the agent instead gave a personalised recommendation at 01:31.
